canonical_encoding.text: UTF-8 lines terminated by '\n'; integer fields joined by ';'
canonical_encoding.digest: sha256 lowercase hex over concatenated line bytes; all wall faces hashed
canonical_encoding.wall_faces: per emitted wall face, deterministic emit order (cliff pairs sorted by (min_tile, max_tile) lexicographic (q, r), segments in chain order, deduped faces omitted): QA;RA;QB;RB;SEG;V0;V1;V2[;V3] with oriented N3a node indices
canonical_encoding.wall_height_stats: informational floats (12 significant digits); Godot compares with 1e-6 tolerance against its own solver heights
